title: Phone remote
guidance: The phone and this computer must share a network.
noDevices: None yet. Use the phone button in the title bar.

steps.label: Pairing steps
steps.allow: Match the code, then select Allow.

firewall: If Windows asks, allow private networks only.
firewallPublic: If Windows asks, allow public networks too.

errors.no-interface: No network found. It turns on once Wi-Fi or a cable connects.
errors.choose-interface: Choose the network your phone uses.
errors.public-network: This is a public network. Set it to private in Windows, or use it anyway.
errors.port-in-use: Another app is blocking the connection; it retries once that app closes.
errors.secure-storage-unavailable: This computer can't encrypt pairing data right now, so the phone remote can't turn on.
errors.listen-failed: The phone remote couldn't turn on. Try again later.
errors.not-running: The connection isn't ready yet. Wait a moment.
errors.invalid: That setting isn't valid. Choose again.
errors.read-failed: The phone remote status can't be read right now.

unpaired.title: Phone not paired
unpaired.detail: Pair your phone to follow lyrics and control playback.

connecting.title: Connecting to the computer
connecting.detail: Keep Utawakui open on the computer.

connectFailed.title: Could not reach the computer
connectFailed.detail: Check that Mobile Remote is on and both devices are on the same network. This page will retry automatically.

pairing.title: Sending pairing request
pairing.detail: Look for the pairing prompt on the computer.

awaiting-approval.title: Waiting for computer approval
awaiting-approval.detail: Check that the codes match, then choose Allow on the computer.

pairing-failed.title: Pairing could not finish
pairing-failed.detail: The pairing code may have expired or already been used. Generate a new QR code on the computer and scan it.

pairing-denied.title: Pairing was declined
pairing-denied.detail: Get a new QR code from the computer. Scan it, check the codes, and choose Allow on the computer.

pairing-busy.title: The computer is confirming another phone
pairing-busy.detail: Wait for that pairing to finish, then scan the QR code again.

devices-full.title: Paired phone limit reached
devices-full.detail: Remove an unused phone in the computer’s settings, then try pairing again.

displaced.title: Another phone is connected
displaced.detail: Use the button below to control playback from this phone.

stopped.title: Disconnected
stopped.detail: Check that Mobile Remote is on, then reload this page.

steps.network: Connect the phone and computer to the same network.
steps.desktop: Open Utawakui on the computer and select the phone button in the title bar.
steps.scan: Scan the QR code on the computer with your phone’s camera.

queue.empty: No tracks are queued to play next.

lyrics.noLyrics: No lyrics available for this track

templates.outputUnavailable: Output template settings are currently unavailable.

remote.mixUnavailable: Available when the track uses separate audio stems.
remote.mixFollowsCapture: Monitor guide vocals currently follow the capture output.
remote.label: Remote
remote.lockScreenHint: Pauses other audio on this phone.
remote.lockScreenFailed: Couldn't turn on lock screen controls.

results.stale: The display just changed. Tap again.
results.unavailable: Can't do that now. Check that the computer is playing.
results.busy: The computer is busy. Try again shortly.
results.timed_out: The computer didn't respond. Try again.

approval.label: Confirm new phone
approval.title: Allow “{name}” to connect?
approval.hint: The phone should show the same code; if it isn't yours, deny.
